kiro.shortDescription: Delegate implementation to Kiro CLI to save tokens.
kiro.longDescription: Plan with Codex, hand off implementation tasks to Kiro CLI (flat-rate subscription credits) inside an isolated git worktree, verify with tests. Falls back to the host writing the code when Kiro's fix-loop is exhausted. (The Kiro-run pre-commit review and /kiro:* commands are Claude Code-only — this Codex manifest exposes the implementation-delegation skill only.)

kiro-power-converter.shortDescription: Convert Claude plugin content into Kiro Power packages.
kiro-power-converter.longDescription: Use Codex to analyze Claude Code plugins and generate Kiro Power compatible skill packages, conversion reports, and migration guidance.
defaultPrompt: Convert this plugin to Kiro Power.
Convert this skill to Kiro format.

co-agent.shortDescription: Coordinate multi-AI review and decision workflows.
co-agent.longDescription: Use Codex with co-agent workflows for multi-agent code review, architecture review, decision support, ADR co-authoring, AI context synchronization, and autonomous consensus/harness implementation pipelines. In Codex, Codex chairs while Claude CLI, Kiro CLI, and Agy provide advisory opinions.

aws-ops-plugin.shortDescription: Troubleshoot, review, and operate AWS and EKS environments.
aws-ops-plugin.longDescription: Use Codex skills for AWS operations workflows including troubleshooting, health checks, network diagnosis, observability, security audit, and Well-Architected review.

aws-content-plugin.shortDescription: Create AWS presentations, diagrams, docs, GitBook sites, workshops, and brochures.
aws-content-plugin.longDescription: Build AWS-focused content with reusable Codex skills for reactive presentations, architecture diagrams, animated diagrams, GitBook pages, workshops, brochures, and slide quality fixes.

atlas.shortDescription: Per-topic docs that stay in sync with the code.
atlas.longDescription: Maintain a per-topic repository wiki with mechanically detected documentation drift. Repair stale docs in the current host; Claude-backed unattended sync is an optional, separately configured workflow.
defaultPrompt: Check which atlas docs have drifted from the code.

agentcore-creator.shortDescription: Convert plugin workflows into Bedrock AgentCore artifacts.
agentcore-creator.longDescription: Use Codex to map Claude Code plugin assets into Amazon Bedrock AgentCore runtimes, gateways, memory stores, Lambda functions, and deployment guidance.

project-init.shortDescription: Initialize and maintain Codex and Claude Code projects.
project-init.longDescription: Project detection, scoped instructions, skills, documentation, ADRs, runbooks and project health checks with host-specific setup guidance.
